How to work this

The app, filed by job — after the consolidation — 15 categories, 70 screens. The sixteen overlap families were merged: every job now has one front door, and what a door absorbed is written under its category name. Each screen gets keep / rework / cut. Nothing is sent anywhere; it saves in this browser, and Export my verdict gives you text to paste back to me.

J / K move · 1 keep · 2 rework · 3 cut · 0 clear · N note. Skipping is fine — not judged brings you back.
